data.name: Rosalinda
data.long_meaning: The name Rosalinda is derived from the Latin and Greek roots: Rosa (rose) and linda (beautiful or gentle). The name symbolizes beauty, grace, and strength, much like the flower it is named after. In Christian tradition, the rose is a symbol of the Virgin Mary and her purity.

Its association with the rose also connects it to the rich cultural history of Romance languages and literature. data.spiritual_significance: The name Rosalinda holds deep spiritual significance, as it evokes the image of the Blessed Virgin Mary and the purity of the rose she holds in Christian iconography. This name's connection to the Virgin Mary highlights its importance in Christian tradition and represents a reminder of the virtues of beauty, grace, and purity. Additionally, the rose symbolizes the love and devotion between God and his people, making Rosalinda a spiritually profound and meaningful name.
